children: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TWSE:2330) posted strong revenue and margins with hefty capex guidance, is scaling advanced chips for Xiaomi and expanding COUPE silicon photonics and fabs in Taichung, while rising electricity use pressures its push to 60% renewables by 2030.
Taiwan Semiconductor 2025 Revenue; Q2 Gross/Operating Margin
: TSMC (2330) July revenue NT$467.6B, +44.7% YoY; 7‑month revenue NT$2.872T, +37% YTD. Q2 sales +$40.2B, gross margin 67.7%, operating margin 60.3%. 2026 capex $60–$64B; Q3 rev guide $44.6–45.8B.
: TSMC (2330) is producing three Xiaomi chips: 3nm Xring O3 smartphone SoC (mass production), 6nm Xring O100 NPU for on-device LLMs (planned next year), and 3nm Xring D100 for AVs (planned next year)
: TSMC (2330) expands its COUPE silicon photonics beyond A14, using Taichung optical cluster. Fab 15A makes interposers; Fab 25 Phase 2 adds four A14 fabs (two under build).
: TSMC (2330) electricity use rose 12.6% to 28.77 billion kWh in 2025 — about 10% of Taiwan’s power. Targets: 60% renewables by 2030, 100% by 2040, net-zero by 2050.
